q: 他___房间里换衣服。
zh: 他在房间里换衣服。
py: tā zài fáng jiān lǐ huàn yī fu
en: He is changing his clothes in the room.
why: 在 + place goes before the verb to say where the action happens. 从 and 往 need a starting point or a direction of movement, and 离 compares distance, so none of them fits 换衣服.

q: 邻居每天早上___小区里跑步。
zh: 邻居每天早上在小区里跑步。
py: lín jū měi tiān zǎo shang zài xiǎo qū lǐ pǎo bù
en: My neighbour jogs in the housing complex every morning.
why: 在 + place before the verb gives the setting of the jogging. 跟 and 给 need a person, and 向 faces a person or direction, not a place where an activity happens.

q: 我周末想___新邻居一起去逛街。
zh: 我周末想跟新邻居一起去逛街。
py: wǒ zhōu mò xiǎng gēn xīn lín jū yī qǐ qù guàng jiē
en: I want to go shopping with my new neighbour at the weekend.
why: 一起 shows a companion doing the action together with you, so the coverb is 跟. 给 marks a recipient and 对 an attitude; neither can sit with 一起去.

q: 她每次都___朋友一起去商场挑衣服，从来不一个人去。
zh: 她每次都跟朋友一起去商场挑衣服，从来不一个人去。
py: tā měi cì dōu gēn péng you yī qǐ qù shāng chǎng tiāo yī fu cóng lái bù yī gè rén qù
en: She always goes to the mall with friends to pick out clothes and never goes alone.
why: The contrast with 一个人 shows a companion, and a companion before the verb is 跟. 为 is for whose sake, 给 for a recipient and 对 for an attitude, so none of them can pair with 一起去.

q: 那家店太贵了，以后我再也___在那儿买衣服了。
zh: 那家店太贵了，以后我再也不在那儿买衣服了。
py: nà jiā diàn tài guì le yǐ hòu wǒ zài yě bù zài nà r mǎi yī fu le
en: That shop is too expensive; I'll never buy clothes there again.
why: 不 negates a decision about the future and sits before the coverb phrase 在那儿. 没 would deny a past event, which clashes with 以后, and 别 is an order to someone else.

q: 我家离地铁站___远，走十分钟就到。
zh: 我家离地铁站不远，走十分钟就到。
py: wǒ jiā lí dì tiě zhàn bù yuǎn zǒu shí fēn zhōng jiù dào
en: My home isn't far from the subway station; it's a ten-minute walk.
why: 远 is an adjective, so 不 sits right on it, after 离地铁站. 没 does not negate adjectives, and 很远 would say the opposite of a ten-minute walk.

q: 他对我___好，所以我不想跟他说话。
zh: 他对我不好，所以我不想跟他说话。
py: tā duì wǒ bù hǎo suǒ yǐ wǒ bù xiǎng gēn tā shuō huà
en: He isn't nice to me, so I don't want to talk to him.
why: 好 is the predicate, so 不 goes directly before it, after 对我. 没 does not negate an adjective, and 别 would be a command.

q: 昨天晚上邻居___给我打电话，我还以为他出门了。
zh: 昨天晚上邻居没给我打电话，我还以为他出门了。
py: zuó tiān wǎn shang lín jū méi gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà wǒ hái yǐ wéi tā chū mén le
en: The neighbour didn't call me last night; I thought he had gone out.
why: A call that did not happen yesterday is denied with 没, placed before the coverb 给我. 不 does not report a specific past event, and 别 is a command.

q: 这条裙子的颜色跟我那条___一样，我想买下来。
zh: 这条裙子的颜色跟我那条不一样，我想买下来。
py: zhè tiáo qún zi de yán sè gēn wǒ nà tiáo bù yī yàng wǒ xiǎng mǎi xià lai
en: The colour of this skirt is different from my other one, so I want to buy it.
why: 不一样 negates the state 一样 and follows the phrase 跟我那条. 没 cannot negate 一样, and 很一样 is not said.

q: 我跟邻居关系很好，我丈夫___跟他们很熟。
zh: 我跟邻居关系很好，我丈夫也跟他们很熟。
py: wǒ gēn lín jū guān xi hěn hǎo wǒ zhàng fu yě gēn tā men hěn shú
en: I get on well with the neighbours, and my husband is close to them too.
why: 也 means 'too' and stands before the coverb phrase 跟他们, ahead of 很熟. 不 or 没 would contradict the good relations just mentioned, and 别 is an imperative.

q: 房东之前___对我们说过房租会涨，所以我们很意外。
zh: 房东之前没对我们说过房租会涨，所以我们很意外。
py: fáng dōng zhī qián méi duì wǒ men shuō guo fáng zū huì zhǎng suǒ yǐ wǒ men hěn yì wài
en: The landlord hadn't told us before that the rent would go up, so we were surprised.
why: The negative of 说过 (an experience) is 没, and it sits before the coverb 对我们. 不 cannot combine with 过 here, and 会 would make no sense with 过.

q: 你___给他打电话了，他正在开会。
zh: 你别给他打电话了，他正在开会。
py: nǐ bié gěi tā dǎ diàn huà le tā zhèng zài kāi huì
en: Don't call him again; he's in a meeting.
why: 别 makes a request and stands before the coverb 给他. 没 reports a past fact, while 也 and 都 do not make a request, so only 别 fits the situation.

q: 我家___学校很近。
zh: 我家离学校很近。
py: wǒ jiā lí xué xiào hěn jìn
en: My home is very close to school.
why: 离 measures the gap between two places and is followed by 近 or 远. 从 needs a movement that starts there, and 往 needs a direction.

q: 房东___下个月开始收新房租。
zh: 房东从下个月开始收新房租。
py: fáng dōng cóng xià gè yuè kāi shǐ shōu xīn fáng zū
en: The landlord will start charging the new rent from next month.
why: 从 marks the point in time when something starts, here paired with 开始. 离 would count the gap to a date and go with 还有 + time instead.

q: 我家___超市有三百米。
zh: 我家离超市有三百米。
py: wǒ jiā lí chāo shì yǒu sān bǎi mǐ
en: My home is three hundred metres from the supermarket.
why: A distance between two fixed points is 离 + place + 有 + amount. 从 and 到 describe a journey, and 往 a direction.

q: 他___楼下走上来，手里拿着新衣服。
zh: 他从楼下走上来，手里拿着新衣服。
py: tā cóng lóu xià zǒu shàng lai shǒu lǐ ná zhe xīn yī fu
en: He walked up from downstairs with new clothes in his hands.
why: 从 marks where the movement starts, and 走上来 shows motion. 离 gives a gap, not a start, and 在 gives a fixed place, which does not fit 走上来.

q: 我现在住的地方___公司只有十分钟的路。
zh: 我现在住的地方离公司只有十分钟的路。
py: wǒ xiàn zài zhù de dì fang lí gōng sī zhǐ yǒu shí fēn zhōng de lù
en: The place where I live now is only ten minutes from the office.
why: 只有十分钟的路 states the gap between two places, which is 离. 从 would need a movement verb and 到.

q: ___我家到地铁站，走路要十五分钟。
zh: 从我家到地铁站，走路要十五分钟。
py: cóng wǒ jiā dào dì tiě zhàn zǒu lù yào shí wǔ fēn zhōng
en: From my home to the subway station it takes fifteen minutes on foot.
why: 从…到 frames a route from its start to its end, and the blank opens that frame. 离 never pairs with 到 to frame a route.

q: ___搬家还有一个星期，东西还没收拾好。
zh: 离搬家还有一个星期，东西还没收拾好。
py: lí bān jiā hái yǒu yī gè xīng qī dōng xi hái méi shōu shi hǎo
en: There is still a week until we move, and the things aren't packed yet.
why: 还有 + time after a point in time is the 离 pattern: the gap to moving day. 从 starts a period and 到 ends one, neither expresses the time left.

q: 这件大衣___去年冬天就一直挂在柜子里。
zh: 这件大衣从去年冬天就一直挂在柜子里。
py: zhè jiàn dà yī cóng qù nián dōng tiān jiù yī zhí guà zài guì zi lǐ
en: This coat has been hanging in the wardrobe ever since last winter.
why: 从…就一直 marks the starting time of a state that continues up to now. 离 would measure the gap to a time, which does not fit.

q: 这套房子___地铁站很近，但是从这儿到市中心要坐四十分钟的车。
zh: 这套房子离地铁站很近，但是从这儿到市中心要坐四十分钟的车。
py: zhè tào fáng zi lí dì tiě zhàn hěn jìn dàn shì cóng zhè r dào shì zhōng xīn yào zuò sì shí fēn zhōng de chē
en: This flat is very close to the subway station, but it takes forty minutes by car from here to the city centre.
why: 很近 describes a gap between two places, so 离. The second clause is a route with a start and an end, which is why it uses 从…到 instead.

q: 我们小区___大门进去，右边就是物业办公室。
zh: 我们小区从大门进去，右边就是物业办公室。
py: wǒ men xiǎo qū cóng dà mén jìn qu yòu bian jiù shì wù yè bàn gōng shì
en: Go in through the main gate of our complex and the property office is right there on the right.
why: 从 marks the entry point of a movement, 从大门进去. 离 gives a gap, and 在 gives a fixed place, so neither fits a verb of going in.

q: 房东___我们很好。
zh: 房东对我们很好。
py: fáng dōng duì wǒ men hěn hǎo
en: The landlord is very good to us.
why: 对 introduces the target of an attitude, followed by an adjective like 好. 给 needs a thing or service passed on, and 往 is for direction.

q: 我想___妈妈买一条围巾。
zh: 我想给妈妈买一条围巾。
py: wǒ xiǎng gěi mā ma mǎi yī tiáo wéi jīn
en: I want to buy a scarf for my mum.
why: The receiver of something bought is marked by 给 before the verb. 对 would be an attitude, 跟 a partner and 向 a direction, none of which makes mum the recipient.

q: 我哥哥___运动鞋很感兴趣。
zh: 我哥哥对运动鞋很感兴趣。
py: wǒ gē ge duì yùn dòng xié hěn gǎn xìng qù
en: My older brother is very interested in sports shoes.
why: 感兴趣 takes its target with 对. 跟 would suggest a partner doing something together, and 给 a recipient.

q: 我下午要___房东商量一下房租的事。
zh: 我下午要跟房东商量一下房租的事。
py: wǒ xià wǔ yào gēn fáng dōng shāng liang yī xià fáng zū de shì
en: This afternoon I'm going to talk the rent over with the landlord.
why: 商量 is done together, so the other party is 跟 / 和 + person. 对 would be an attitude, 给 a recipient and 向 a direction; none can precede 商量 here.

q: 这种面料___皮肤很好，夏天穿特别舒服。
zh: 这种面料对皮肤很好，夏天穿特别舒服。
py: zhè zhǒng miàn liào duì pí fū hěn hǎo xià tiān chuān tè bié shū fu
en: This fabric is good for the skin and especially comfortable in summer.
why: Being good for something expresses an effect on it, which is 对. 给 would need something handed to the skin, and 跟 a partner.

q: 邻居常常___我们送一些自己种的菜。
zh: 邻居常常给我们送一些自己种的菜。
py: lín jū cháng cháng gěi wǒ men sòng yī xiē zì jǐ zhòng de cài
en: Our neighbour often gives us some vegetables he grew himself.
why: Vegetables handed over need a recipient, which is 给 + person before 送. 对 is an attitude and 跟 means doing it together with someone.

q: 我想___你介绍一下我们的新邻居。
zh: 我想给你介绍一下我们的新邻居。
py: wǒ xiǎng gěi nǐ jiè shào yī xià wǒ men de xīn lín jū
en: I'd like to introduce our new neighbour to you.
why: 介绍 passes information to a person, so the receiver takes 给. 对 would be an attitude, and 跟 would mean introducing together with you.

q: 她从来不___别人比较衣服的价格，只买自己喜欢的。
zh: 她从来不跟别人比较衣服的价格，只买自己喜欢的。
py: tā cóng lái bù gēn bié rén bǐ jiào yī fu de jià gé zhǐ mǎi zì jǐ xǐ huan de
en: She never compares the prices of clothes with other people; she only buys what she likes.
why: 比较 is done between two parties, so the other party takes 跟. 对 would be an attitude, 给 a recipient and 为 whose sake, which makes no sense with 比较.

q: 穿太紧的裤子___身体不好，医生建议大家别穿。
zh: 穿太紧的裤子对身体不好，医生建议大家别穿。
py: chuān tài jǐn de kù zi duì shēn tǐ bù hǎo yī shēng jiàn yì dà jiā bié chuān
en: Wearing trousers that are too tight is bad for your health, and doctors advise against it.
why: The effect on the body is marked with 对, and 不好 follows it. 跟 and 给 would turn the body into a partner or a recipient.

q: 我已经___房东谈好了，下个月不用再交押金。
zh: 我已经跟房东谈好了，下个月不用再交押金。
py: wǒ yǐ jīng gēn fáng dōng tán hǎo le xià gè yuè bù yòng zài jiāo yā jīn
en: I've already settled it with the landlord, so there's no need to pay a deposit again next month.
why: 谈好 is an agreement reached together, so the other party takes 跟. 对 and 给 cannot mark a partner in a negotiation.

q: 出了大门，___右拐就是我家。
zh: 出了大门，往右拐就是我家。
py: chū le dà mén wǎng yòu guǎi jiù shì wǒ jiā
en: Once you're out of the gate, turn right and that's my place.
why: 往 + direction + a verb of movement (拐). 在 marks a fixed place and 从 a starting point, so neither gives the direction of turning.

q: 我们应该___那位老邻居学习，他八十岁了还天天锻炼。
zh: 我们应该向那位老邻居学习，他八十岁了还天天锻炼。
py: wǒ men yīng gāi xiàng nà wèi lǎo lín jū xué xí tā bā shí suì le hái tiān tiān duàn liàn
en: We should learn from that elderly neighbour; at eighty he still exercises every day.
why: Learning from a person is 向 + person + 学习. 往 needs a direction or place, and 为 means for the sake of.

q: 我不小心把邻居的花瓶打碎了，赶紧___他道歉。
zh: 我不小心把邻居的花瓶打碎了，赶紧向他道歉。
py: wǒ bù xiǎo xīn bǎ lín jū de huā píng dǎ suì le gǎn jǐn xiàng tā dào qiàn
en: I accidentally broke my neighbour's vase and quickly apologised to him.
why: 道歉 is an abstract act addressed to a person, which is 向 + person. 往 needs a place or direction, 在 a location and 从 a starting point.

q: 你___前走五十米，就能看到那家服装店。
zh: 你往前走五十米，就能看到那家服装店。
py: nǐ wǎng qián zǒu wǔ shí mǐ jiù néng kàn dào nà jiā fú zhuāng diàn
en: Walk fifty metres straight ahead and you'll see that clothes shop.
why: 往前走 is the standard way to say 'head straight on'. 在前 would be a place, 从前 would read as 'formerly', and 对 faces a target.

q: 他走到门口，___我们挥了挥手就走了。
zh: 他走到门口，朝我们挥了挥手就走了。
py: tā zǒu dào mén kǒu cháo wǒ men huī le huī shǒu jiù zǒu le
en: He got to the door, waved at us and left.
why: 朝 + person + a gesture such as 挥手 means facing the people. 往 needs a place or direction, 从 a starting point and 为 means for the sake of.

q: 电梯坏了，请大家___楼梯口走，注意别摔倒。
zh: 电梯坏了，请大家往楼梯口走，注意别摔倒。
py: diàn tī huài le qǐng dà jiā wǎng lóu tī kǒu zǒu zhù yì bié shuāi dǎo
en: The lift is broken; please head for the stairs and be careful not to fall.
why: 往 + place + a verb of movement (走) gives the direction of travel. 在 would say the walking happens at the stairs, and 对 and 为 do not mark direction.

q: 听说你搬进新家了，我真___你高兴。
zh: 听说你搬进新家了，我真为你高兴。
py: tīng shuō nǐ bān jìn xīn jiā le wǒ zhēn wèi nǐ gāo xìng
en: I heard you've moved into a new home; I'm really happy for you.
why: Being happy on someone's account is 为 + person + 高兴. 对 would aim the feeling at the person, which 高兴 does not allow, and 给 and 跟 do not mark feelings.

q: 你别___我担心，我自己能搬。
zh: 你别为我担心，我自己能搬。
py: nǐ bié wèi wǒ dān xīn wǒ zì jǐ néng bān
en: Don't worry about me; I can move it myself.
why: Worrying on someone's account is 为 + person + 担心. 对 cannot mark the cause of worry, and 给 needs a thing given to someone.

q: 我今天感冒了，你能___我去房东那儿交房租吗？
zh: 我今天感冒了，你能替我去房东那儿交房租吗？
py: wǒ jīn tiān gǎn mào le nǐ néng tì wǒ qù fáng dōng nà r jiāo fáng zū ma
en: I've got a cold today. Can you go to the landlord's to pay the rent for me?
why: Because I am ill, the friend would act in my place, which is 替. 对 would be an attitude and 跟 would mean going together with me.

q: 我们都___他搬进新家感到高兴。
zh: 我们都为他搬进新家感到高兴。
py: wǒ men dōu wèi tā bān jìn xīn jiā gǎn dào gāo xìng
en: We're all happy that he has moved into a new home.
why: 为 introduces the person or event that causes the happiness. 替 means doing something in someone's place, which makes no sense with 高兴.

q: 妈妈不在家，你可以___她把这件衣服收下来吗？
zh: 妈妈不在家，你可以替她把这件衣服收下来吗？
py: mā ma bù zài jiā nǐ kě yǐ tì tā bǎ zhè jiàn yī fu shōu xià lai ma
en: Mum isn't home. Could you take this piece of clothing in for her?
why: 替 means doing her job in her place while she is away. 对 would aim an attitude at her, and 跟 would mean doing it together with her.

q: 房东___住户服务了二十年，大家都很尊敬他。
zh: 房东为住户服务了二十年，大家都很尊敬他。
py: fáng dōng wèi zhù hù fú wù le èr shí nián dà jiā dōu hěn zūn jìng tā
en: The landlord has served the residents for twenty years, and everyone respects him.
why: 为 + people + 服务 means serving them for their benefit. 向 faces a person to learn or apologise, and 对 and 跟 do not fit 服务.

q: 他每天___公共汽车去学校。
zh: 他每天坐公共汽车去学校。
py: tā měi tiān zuò gōng gòng qì chē qù xué xiào
en: He goes to school by bus every day.
why: A vehicle you ride as a passenger takes 坐 before 去. 骑 is for bikes and 开 for driving, and 用 is for tools.

q: 她___筷子吃饭，不用叉子。
zh: 她用筷子吃饭，不用叉子。
py: tā yòng kuài zi chī fàn bù yòng chā zi
en: She eats with chopsticks and doesn't use a fork.
why: A tool used for the action takes 用 before the verb: 用筷子吃饭. 坐 is for vehicles, and 跟 and 给 mark people.

q: 我儿子每天自己___自行车去上学。
zh: 我儿子每天自己骑自行车去上学。
py: wǒ ér zi měi tiān zì jǐ qí zì xíng chē qù shàng xué
en: My son rides his bike to school by himself every day.
why: 自己 and a bicycle call for 骑, since he pedals it himself. 坐 would make him a passenger and 开 is for cars.

q: 搬家的时候，我们___一辆小卡车把家具运过去。
zh: 搬家的时候，我们用一辆小卡车把家具运过去。
py: bān jiā de shí hou wǒ men yòng yī liàng xiǎo kǎ chē bǎ jiā jù yùn guò qu
en: When we moved, we used a small truck to carry the furniture over.
why: The truck is the tool for moving the furniture, so 用 comes before the verb. 坐 would make us passengers, but the furniture is what travels.

q: 雨太大了，你___出租车回去吧，别走路了。
zh: 雨太大了，你坐出租车回去吧，别走路了。
py: yǔ tài dà le nǐ zuò chū zū chē huí qu ba bié zǒu lù le
en: The rain is too heavy; take a taxi back instead of walking.
why: Riding in a taxi as a passenger is 坐. 骑 is for bikes, 开 means driving it yourself, and 用 marks a tool.

q: 这件羊毛衫很容易缩水，最好___冷水手洗，不要放进洗衣机。
zh: 这件羊毛衫很容易缩水，最好用冷水手洗，不要放进洗衣机。
py: zhè jiàn yáng máo shān hěn róng yì suō shuǐ zuì hǎo yòng lěng shuǐ shǒu xǐ bù yào fàng jìn xǐ yī jī
en: This wool jumper shrinks easily, so it is best washed by hand in cold water, not put in the washing machine.
why: Cold water is the means of washing, so 用 comes before 手洗. 坐 is for vehicles, 往 for direction and 给 for a recipient.

q: 请把书放___桌子上。
zh: 请把书放在桌子上。
py: qǐng bǎ shū fàng zài zhuō zi shàng
en: Please put the book on the table.
why: 放 plus 在 shows where the book ends up, and 在 attaches straight to the verb. 给 would name a receiver, and 着 or 过 cannot lead into 桌子上.

q: 我把这封信寄___朋友了。
zh: 我把这封信寄给朋友了。
py: wǒ bǎ zhè fēng xìn jì gěi péng you le
en: I sent this letter to my friend.
why: 寄 + 给 + person: the friend is the receiver. 在 and 到 need a place, not a person.

q: 搬家公司已经把冰箱送___新家了。
zh: 搬家公司已经把冰箱送到新家了。
py: bān jiā gōng sī yǐ jīng bǎ bīng xiāng sòng dào xīn jiā le
en: The removal company has already delivered the fridge to the new home.
why: 送 + 到 + place: the fridge travels to the new home. 在 would say it stays there, and 给 needs a person.

q: 她把那件红色的外套挂___窗户旁边的衣架上了。
zh: 她把那件红色的外套挂在窗户旁边的衣架上了。
py: tā bǎ nà jiàn hóng sè de wài tào guà zài chuāng hu páng biān de yī jià shàng le
en: She hung that red coat on the hanger by the window.
why: 挂 + 在 + place says where the coat ends up hanging. 给 would need a person, and 着 or 过 cannot take a place after them.

q: 我已经把房租交___房东了，他还给了我一张收据。
zh: 我已经把房租交给房东了，他还给了我一张收据。
py: wǒ yǐ jīng bǎ fáng zū jiāo gěi fáng dōng le tā hái gěi le wǒ yī zhāng shōu jù
en: I've already paid the rent to the landlord, and he even gave me a receipt.
why: 交 + 给 + person: the landlord receives the rent. 在 and 到 mark a place, which would turn the landlord into a location.

zh: 小王明天在楼下等我们。
py: xiǎo wáng míng tiān zài lóu xià děng wǒ men
en: Xiao Wang will wait for us downstairs tomorrow.
why: The place phrase 在楼下 stands before the verb 等. The time word may come before or after the subject, but 在楼下 cannot follow 等我们.

zh: 我们想和房东谈房租。
py: wǒ men xiǎng hé fáng dōng tán fáng zū
en: We'd like to discuss the rent with the landlord.
why: The partner phrase 和房东 comes before 谈, after the modal 想. Putting 房东 after 谈 would make a different, wrong sentence.

zh: 她跟同学一起去买衣服。
py: tā gēn tóng xué yī qǐ qù mǎi yī fu
en: She's going to buy clothes with her classmates.
why: 跟同学 comes before 一起 and the verbs. 一起 cannot precede 跟, and 同学 cannot trail at the end.

zh: 他每个周末都在阳台上晒衣服。
py: tā měi gè zhōu mò dōu zài yáng tái shàng shài yī fu
en: He dries his clothes on the balcony every weekend.
why: 都 follows 每个周末 and 在阳台上 comes before 晒衣服. The place cannot be put after the verb.

zh: 我不想跟邻居吵架。
py: wǒ bù xiǎng gēn lín jū chǎo jià
en: I don't want to quarrel with the neighbours.
why: 不 and the modal 想 come before the coverb phrase 跟邻居. 吵架 takes no object, so the neighbour must be introduced with 跟.

zh: 他昨天没给房东打电话。
py: tā zuó tiān méi gěi fáng dōng dǎ diàn huà
en: He didn't call the landlord yesterday.
why: 没 goes before the coverb 给房东, not between 给房东 and 打电话. The time word 昨天 may sit before or after the subject.

zh: 从我家到公司要四十分钟。
py: cóng wǒ jiā dào gōng sī yào sì shí fēn zhōng
en: It takes forty minutes from my home to the office.
why: A route with a start and an end is framed by 从…到. The duration 要四十分钟 comes last.

zh: 他对新邻居很热情。
py: tā duì xīn lín jū hěn rè qíng
en: He is very warm toward the new neighbours.
why: 对 + target comes before the adjective predicate 热情, and 很 sits on the adjective. 很 cannot precede 对.

zh: 你往前走一百米就到了。
py: nǐ wǎng qián zǒu yī bǎi mǐ jiù dào le
en: Walk a hundred metres straight ahead and you'll be there.
why: 往 + direction comes before the movement verb 走, and the distance follows the verb. 往 cannot come after 走.

zh: 你能替我给花浇水吗？
py: nǐ néng tì wǒ gěi huā jiāo shuǐ ma
en: Could you water the flowers for me?
why: The modal 能 comes before 替我, and the acting-in-my-place phrase precedes the verb 浇水. 替我 cannot come after 浇水.

zh: 他骑自行车去超市。
py: tā qí zì xíng chē qù chāo shì
en: He rides his bike to the supermarket.
why: How you travel comes first: 骑自行车, then the verb of going. The destination 超市 closes the sentence.

zh: 你可以用手机付房租。
py: nǐ kě yǐ yòng shǒu jī fù fáng zū
en: You can pay the rent with your phone.
why: The modal 可以 comes first, then the tool phrase 用手机, then the verb 付. 用手机 cannot follow 房租.

zh: 我们打算坐公共汽车去新家看看。
py: wǒ men dǎ suàn zuò gōng gòng qì chē qù xīn jiā kàn kan
en: We plan to take a bus to look at the new home.
why: 坐公共汽车 states the means before the verb 去. 打算 stays in front of the whole chain, and 坐公共汽车 cannot follow 去 or 看看.

zh: 我把外套挂在衣架上了。
py: wǒ bǎ wài tào guà zài yī jià shàng le
en: I hung the coat on the hanger.
why: 在 attaches directly to 挂 because the hanger is where the coat ends up. 了 can close the sentence or follow 在. 在衣架上 cannot move before 挂.

zh: 他把新买的沙发送到我家了。
py: tā bǎ xīn mǎi de shā fā sòng dào wǒ jiā le
en: He delivered the sofa he just bought to my home.
why: 到 attaches directly to 送 because my home is where the sofa ends up. 了 can follow 我家 or come right after 到, but 到我家 cannot stand before 送.

src_py: fáng dōng duì wǒ men hěn hǎo
task: Say he is not good to us.
zh: 房东对我们不好。
py: fáng dōng duì wǒ men bù hǎo
en: The landlord is not good to us.
why: 好 is an adjective predicate, so 不 goes right on it, after 对我们. Putting 不 before 对 gives a different, unnatural sentence.

src_py: xīn jiā lí dì tiě zhàn hěn yuǎn
zh: 新家离地铁站不远。
py: xīn jiā lí dì tiě zhàn bù yuǎn
en: The new home is not far from the subway station.
why: 远 is the predicate, so 不 replaces 很 right before it, after 离地铁站. 不 cannot go before 离.

src_py: wǒ xiě xìn gěi xīn lín jū
task: Put the receiver before the verb with 给.
zh: 我给新邻居写信。
py: wǒ gěi xīn lín jū xiě xìn
en: I'm writing a letter to the new neighbour.
why: The default order puts the receiver in a 给 phrase before the verb: 给新邻居写信. Leaving 给 after 写信 is the English-style order.

src_py: tā kàn zhe wǒ xiào le xiào
task: Say he smiled toward me, using 朝.
zh: 他朝我笑了笑。
py: tā cháo wǒ xiào le xiào
en: He smiled at me.
why: 朝 + person faces the person with a physical gesture such as a smile. The phrase comes before the verb 笑, and 了 sits between the two 笑.

src_py: wǒ bāng nǐ qù jiāo fáng zū ba
task: Use 替: I'll go in your place.
zh: 我替你去交房租吧。
py: wǒ tì nǐ qù jiāo fáng zū ba
en: Let me go and pay the rent for you.
why: 替 + person means doing the job in that person's place, so it comes before the verb 交. 我替你去交 and 我去替你交 are both fine, but 替你 cannot follow 交.

src_py: tā zǒu lù qù gōng sī
zh: 他坐出租车去公司。
py: tā zuò chū zū chē qù gōng sī
en: He goes to the office by taxi.
why: A vehicle you ride in takes 坐 before the verb 去. 骑 and 开 are for bikes and driving yourself.

src: 我用洗衣机洗这件大衣。
src_py: wǒ yòng xǐ yī jī xǐ zhè jiàn dà yī
task: Say you don't use the washing machine for it.
zh: 我不用洗衣机洗这件大衣。
py: wǒ bù yòng xǐ yī jī xǐ zhè jiàn dà yī
en: I don't use the washing machine to wash this coat.
why: 不 negates the coverb 用 and goes right before 用洗衣机. It cannot go before the main verb 洗, which would deny the washing itself.

src_py: wǒ sòng le tā nà tiáo xīn wéi jīn
zh: 我把那条新围巾送给他了。
py: wǒ bǎ nà tiáo xīn wéi jīn sòng gěi tā le
en: I gave him that new scarf.
why: The specific scarf moves forward with 把, and the receiver follows the verb as 送给他, since he is where the scarf ends up. 了 closes the sentence.

src_py: chū zū chē sòng wǒ huí jiā le
task: Rewrite with 把: the taxi took me right to the foot of my building.
zh: 出租车把我送到楼下了。
py: chū zū chē bǎ wǒ sòng dào lóu xià le
en: The taxi took me right to the foot of my building.
why: 到 attaches straight to 送 because the building is where I end up. 了 may follow 楼下 or 到, and 楼下 cannot come before 送.

src_py: wǒ zài qiáng shàng guà le nà fú huà
task: Rewrite with 把 so the picture ends up on the wall.
zh: 我把那幅画挂在墙上了。
py: wǒ bǎ nà fú huà guà zài qiáng shàng le
en: I hung that picture on the wall.
why: Since the wall is where the picture ends up, 在 attaches directly to 挂 and the definite object moves forward with 把. 在墙上 cannot stay before 挂.

s: 我洗衣服在家。
s_py: wǒ xǐ yī fu zài jiā
zh: 我在家洗衣服。
py: wǒ zài jiā xǐ yī fu
en: I wash my clothes at home.
why: The place where an activity happens goes before the verb. English puts 'at home' last, but 在家 must come before 洗衣服.

s: 我明天见面邻居。
s_py: wǒ míng tiān jiàn miàn lín jū
zh: 我明天跟邻居见面。
py: wǒ míng tiān gēn lín jū jiàn miàn
en: I'm meeting the neighbour tomorrow.
why: 见面 cannot take an object, so the other person must be introduced with 跟 or 和 before the verb.

s: 邻居们常常在楼下一起聊天。
s_py: lín jū men cháng cháng zài lóu xià yī qǐ liáo tiān
zh: 邻居们常常在楼下一起聊天。
py: lín jū men cháng cháng zài lóu xià yī qǐ liáo tiān
en: The neighbours often chat together downstairs.
why: The adverb 常常 comes before the place phrase 在楼下, which is followed by 一起 and the verb. Every phrase is in front of 聊天, as it should be.

s: 我们跟房东在电话里谈了房租的事。
s_py: wǒ men gēn fáng dōng zài diàn huà lǐ tán le fáng zū de shì
zh: 我们跟房东在电话里谈了房租的事。
py: wǒ men gēn fáng dōng zài diàn huà lǐ tán le fáng zū de shì
en: We discussed the rent with the landlord on the phone.
why: Both the partner phrase 跟房东 and the place phrase 在电话里 stand before the verb 谈. Two coverb phrases can be stacked in front of one verb.

s: 房东上个月给我们没寄收据，我们很生气。
s_py: fáng dōng shàng gè yuè gěi wǒ men méi jì shōu jù wǒ men hěn shēng qì
zh: 房东上个月没给我们寄收据，我们很生气。
py: fáng dōng shàng gè yuè méi gěi wǒ men jì shōu jù wǒ men hěn shēng qì
en: The landlord didn't send us a receipt last month, and we were angry.
why: With an action verb, 没 goes before the coverb phrase 给我们, not between it and 寄.

s: 我家不离学校远。
s_py: wǒ jiā bù lí xué xiào yuǎn
zh: 我家离学校不远。
py: wǒ jiā lí xué xiào bù yuǎn
en: My home is not far from school.
why: 远 is the predicate, so 不 goes on 远 after 离学校. 不 before 离 is not possible.

s: 我对这件外套的颜色不太满意，可是对价格很满意。
s_py: wǒ duì zhè jiàn wài tào de yán sè bù tài mǎn yì kě shì duì jià gé hěn mǎn yì
zh: 我对这件外套的颜色不太满意，可是对价格很满意。
py: wǒ duì zhè jiàn wài tào de yán sè bù tài mǎn yì kě shì duì jià gé hěn mǎn yì
en: I'm not very satisfied with the colour of this coat, but I'm very satisfied with the price.
why: 满意 is a state predicate, so 不太 and 很 go directly on it after the 对 phrase. That is correct for adjective-type predicates.

s: 新房子从地铁站很远。
s_py: xīn fáng zi cóng dì tiě zhàn hěn yuǎn
zh: 新房子离地铁站很远。
py: xīn fáng zi lí dì tiě zhàn hěn yuǎn
en: The new flat is far from the subway station.
why: The distance between two places is 离, followed by 很远. 从 only marks a starting point of movement or time.

s: 这家店离我家很近，从我家走过去只要五分钟。
s_py: zhè jiā diàn lí wǒ jiā hěn jìn cóng wǒ jiā zǒu guò qu zhǐ yào wǔ fēn zhōng
zh: 这家店离我家很近，从我家走过去只要五分钟。
py: zhè jiā diàn lí wǒ jiā hěn jìn cóng wǒ jiā zǒu guò qu zhǐ yào wǔ fēn zhōng
en: This shop is very close to my home; it's only five minutes on foot from my home.
why: 离 states the gap, 很近, and 从 marks where the walk starts. Each word does its own job even though both mean 'from'.

s: 我对邻居商量搬家的事。
s_py: wǒ duì lín jū shāng liang bān jiā de shì
zh: 我跟邻居商量搬家的事。
py: wǒ gēn lín jū shāng liang bān jiā de shì
en: I'm discussing the move with my neighbour.
why: 商量 is something done together, so the other party takes 跟 or 和. 对 marks an attitude or target, not a discussion partner.

s: 我弟弟跟打扮很感兴趣。
s_py: wǒ dì di gēn dǎ bàn hěn gǎn xìng qù
zh: 我弟弟对打扮很感兴趣。
py: wǒ dì di duì dǎ bàn hěn gǎn xìng qù
en: My younger brother is very interested in dressing up.
why: 感兴趣 takes its target with 对. 跟 is for a partner in a shared activity and cannot mark the topic of interest.

s: 房东对我们说，下个月要来检查水管。
s_py: fáng dōng duì wǒ men shuō xià gè yuè yào lái jiǎn chá shuǐ guǎn
zh: 房东对我们说，下个月要来检查水管。
py: fáng dōng duì wǒ men shuō xià gè yuè yào lái jiǎn chá shuǐ guǎn
en: The landlord told us he will come to check the water pipes next month.
why: With 说, 对 marks the listener and is standard, just like 跟我们说. The phrase sits before the verb.

s: 我想往邻居学习怎么做饭。
s_py: wǒ xiǎng wǎng lín jū xué xí zěn me zuò fàn
zh: 我想向邻居学习怎么做饭。
py: wǒ xiǎng xiàng lín jū xué xí zěn me zuò fàn
en: I want to learn how to cook from my neighbour.
why: 往 needs a direction or place and a movement verb. Learning from a person takes 向.

s: 她朝我们走过来，手里提着一大袋衣服。
s_py: tā cháo wǒ men zǒu guò lai shǒu lǐ tí zhe yī dà dài yī fu
zh: 她朝我们走过来，手里提着一大袋衣服。
py: tā cháo wǒ men zǒu guò lai shǒu lǐ tí zhe yī dà dài yī fu
en: She walked toward us with a big bag of clothes in her hand.
why: 朝 can face a person and combines with a movement verb like 走过来. This is correct, even though 往 would not take 我们.

s: 看到你搬进新家，我真对你高兴。
s_py: kàn dào nǐ bān jìn xīn jiā wǒ zhēn duì nǐ gāo xìng
zh: 看到你搬进新家，我真为你高兴。
py: kàn dào nǐ bān jìn xīn jiā wǒ zhēn wèi nǐ gāo xìng
en: Seeing you move into a new home, I'm really happy for you.
why: Being happy on someone's account takes 为. 对 would aim the feeling at the person, which 高兴 does not allow.

s: 我生病了，朋友替我去交了房租。
s_py: wǒ shēng bìng le péng you tì wǒ qù jiāo le fáng zū
zh: 我生病了，朋友替我去交了房租。
py: wǒ shēng bìng le péng you tì wǒ qù jiāo le fáng zū
en: I was ill, so a friend went to pay the rent for me.
why: 替 means acting in someone's place, which is exactly the situation here: I was ill, so my friend did it instead of me.

s: 我们周末用地铁去逛街。
s_py: wǒ men zhōu mò yòng dì tiě qù guàng jiē
zh: 我们周末坐地铁去逛街。
py: wǒ men zhōu mò zuò dì tiě qù guàng jiē
en: We take the subway to go shopping at the weekend.
why: A vehicle you ride in takes 坐, not 用. 用 is for tools used to carry out the action.

s: 这件丝绸衬衫太贵了，所以我只用手洗，不用洗衣机。
s_py: zhè jiàn sī chóu chèn shān tài guì le suǒ yǐ wǒ zhǐ yòng shǒu xǐ bù yòng xǐ yī jī
zh: 这件丝绸衬衫太贵了，所以我只用手洗，不用洗衣机。
py: zhè jiàn sī chóu chèn shān tài guì le suǒ yǐ wǒ zhǐ yòng shǒu xǐ bù yòng xǐ yī jī
en: This silk shirt is too expensive, so I only wash it by hand and don't use the washing machine.
why: The tools are 手 and 洗衣机, both marked with 用 before the verb. 不 and 只 stand before 用.

s: 他把名字在门上写了。
s_py: tā bǎ míng zi zài mén shàng xiě le
zh: 他把名字写在门上了。
py: tā bǎ míng zi xiě zài mén shàng le
en: He wrote his name on the door.
why: The door is where the name ends up, so 在 must attach directly to 写. 在门上 cannot come before the verb after 把.

s: 她把洗好的衣服一件一件挂在了阳台上。
s_py: tā bǎ xǐ hǎo de yī fu yī jiàn yī jiàn guà zài le yáng tái shàng
zh: 她把洗好的衣服一件一件挂在了阳台上。
py: tā bǎ xǐ hǎo de yī fu yī jiàn yī jiàn guà zài le yáng tái shàng
en: She hung the washed clothes on the balcony one by one.
why: 挂在 stays together as a unit and 了 follows it, before the place. This is correct even though 在 is separated from 阳台上 by 了.
